name: New York

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.

Clothing and footwear under $110 an item are exempt from the 4% state tax; local taxes apply unless the county or city elected the exemption (New York City did). Items $110 and over are taxed in full.
The 4% state tax applies to the first $2 of the price of a gallon (cents-per-gallon); counties may use the same method or percentage rates.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Rates are by county and by the cities that levy their own tax; towns and villages inside a county take the county rate.
Publication 718 (effective March 1, 2025) was the current edition when downloaded in October 2026.
The 3/8% MCTD tax is included in the combined rate of the 12 MCTD jurisdictions; it is a state-administered tax for the MTA, counted here as local.
